IMPORTANT: Read and understand all comments in the code before analyzing,
explaining, or modifying any code.

Rules:
1. Read all existing comments related to the code you are working on.
2. Treat comments as context explaining the purpose, logic, constraints,
   and intended behavior of the code.
3. Follow the instructions written in comments when they are relevant
   to the current task.
4. Before changing code, check whether the change conflicts with any
   existing comments or documented requirements.
5. Do not remove, ignore, or rewrite important comments without a reason.
6. If a comment is unclear, inspect the related code before making assumptions.
7. If the code contradicts its comments, report the discrepancy.
8. Do not assume comments are always correct; verify them against
   the actual implementation.
9. Before making changes, explain which comments and requirements
   are relevant to the task.
10. If a comment describes a constraint, preserve that constraint
    unless I explicitly approve changing it.

Always read the relevant comments first, understand their meaning,
and then proceed with the requested task.
